subject.title: fix: preserve working installs on unsupported Node

question: Is the reported focused validation sufficient, or must the pending Windows and macOS legacy-updater rollback runs complete before this compatibility-sensitive PR lands?
rationale: The code path changes shipped upgrade and lifecycle behavior across three package managers, and only maintainers can accept the remaining cross-platform upgrade uncertainty for release inclusion.

options.title: Require rollback proof
options.body: Wait for redacted Windows and macOS transcripts showing the old installation remains runnable after the candidate rejects unsupported Node.

options.title: Accept existing validation
options.body: Land using the focused tests and package-manager probes while explicitly accepting the remaining affected-platform uncertainty.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Hold the PR if the legacy-updater matrix cannot be reproduced reliably enough to validate the compatibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Require rollback proof
recommendation.body: Wait for redacted Windows and macOS transcripts showing the old installation remains runnable after the candidate rejects unsupported Node.

likelyOwner.reason: Has the strongest updater and release-packaging ownership trail and is positioned to evaluate the pending cross-platform evidence.
